title: Administrator Financial Services
salary_text: £24784 - £26500 per year (A 37.5 hour week excellent benefits)
description:
Administrator - Financial Services

Swansea

£24784 - £26500 PA Negotiable on Experience

The Company

Opportunity to join a Financial Services company based in Swansea SA1. The company provide financial and mortgage solutions for a wide variety of customers and are currently looking for an experienced administrator to take on the role of Bridging and Commercial Case Manager.

The Role

This is a permanent position working in the company offices based in Swansea SA1. You will work from 09:00 AM - 05:30 PM Monday to Friday. A 37.5 hour week

The role requires an experienced administrator. Previous experience in the financial services sector is definitely advantageous but not essential.

Duties and responsibilities include:
- Forwarding Applications to lenders
- Sending out application packs to clients
- Ensuring return of applications
- Reviewing of documentation received
- Liaising with lenders regarding application progress and outcome
- Instructing property valuations and chasing for results
- Reviewing valuation reports
- Ensuring all required legal documentation is requested, completed and returned
- Extensive liaison with customers, lenders and internal colleagues
- Making detailed notes on all case files
- Managing required tasks on a daily basis
- Ensuring computer system is up to date with latest information on all cases

Requirements

The successful applicant will have the following skills, experience and qualities:
- Previous experience in a busy administrative position
- Ideally the applicant will have some experience in financial services or another highly structured sector
- Ability to work on a wide variety of tasks simultaneously
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Solid computer skills
- A quick learner, keen to learn new tasks
- Comfortable working in a busy fast paced environment

In return

The company are offering excellent cross over training for experienced administrators which will give the successful applicant good knowledge and exposure to the financial services sector. The salary is based on relevant experience and offers 25 days leave plus public holidays. Once you have successfully completed your probation the following additional benefits are available
- Additional day off for your Birthday
- Pirkx Subscription for Discounts and Cashback
- Company Events
- Company Pension
- Subsidised Private Medical Insurance
- Financial Planning Services

For more information contact Kim Simpson of Work Wales for a confidential discussion

title: Document Controller
company: Elite Construction Talent Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Document Controller / Project Administrator Construction & Engineering

Location: Swansea, South Wales
Salary: £32,000 £38,000 per annum
Working Arrangement: Full-Time, Fully Site-Based

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an organised and detail-oriented Document Controller / Project Administrator to join an established contractor working on a substantial civil engineering project in South Wales.

This opportunity would suit an experienced Document Controller or a capable administrator looking to develop their career within a technical project environment.

Previous construction experience is desirable but not essential. We particularly welcome applications from candidates with backgrounds in engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, compliance, project administration or other technical environments.

The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate project documentation, organising technical information and supporting the smooth running of document control processes.

Training and support will be available, so we are equally interested in candidates who demonstrate strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and a willingness to learn.

Please note: This is a fully site-based position. Hybrid and remote working are not available.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain project documentation, ensuring information is accurate, organised and readily accessible.
- Maintain document registers, trackers, spreadsheets and electronic filing systems.
- Coordinate the receipt, distribution and tracking of technical drawings, reports and project correspondence.
- Collate and organise quality assurance (QA) documentation and supporting records.
- Ensure documents are correctly filed, updated and issued in accordance with project procedures.
- Monitor outstanding documentation and follow up with relevant team members.
- Maintain accurate document revision records and assist with version control.
- Support engineers, supervisors and project managers with technical information and documentation requirements.
- Assist with preparing documentation for project reporting, inspections and handovers.
- Provide general project administration support as required.

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience in document control, project administration, technical administration, quality administration or a similar role.
- Excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience maintaining accurate records, databases, spreadsheets or electronic filing systems.
- Ability to collate, organise and manage information from multiple sources.
- Good communication skills and confidence liaising with different members of a project team.
- A methodical, proactive and reliable approach to work.
- Ability to prioritise tasks and maintain accuracy in a busy environment.
- Willingness to learn new systems, processes and technical terminology.
- Ability to work on site in the Port Talbot area, Monday to Friday.

Desirable but Not Essential
- Previous experience within construction, civil engineering, manufacturing or another technical industry.
- Familiarity with electronic document management systems (EDMS).
- Experience handling QA documentation, technical drawings or compliance records.
- Experience supporting engineering or project management teams.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £32,000 £38,000 per annum.
- Opportunity to work on a substantial civil engineering project.
- Training and support from experienced colleagues.
- Opportunity to develop specialist document control and technical administration skills.
- Varied responsibilities within an established project team.

Apply Now

If you are an organised, detail-oriented administrator with experience managing documentation, records or technical information, we would be keen to hear from you.

You do not need previous construction experience to be considered. Candidates from engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, compliance and project administration backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Please submit your CV or contact Elite Construction Talent for a confidential discussion.

title: Project Support Administrator
description:
Project Support Administrator
Location: Swansea/Hybrid
Salary: Up to 28,000
CPS Group are currently recruiting for a Project Support Administrator to join a busy and growing programmes team based in Swansea.
This is a varied administrative role supporting the coordination and delivery of multiple projects. Working closely with programme leads, you will play an important part in keeping projects organised, ensuring tasks are completed on time and providing effective support across a range of activities.
The role will suit someone who is highly organised, proactive and enjoys working in a varied, fast-paced environment where no two days are necessarily the same.
The Role
As Project Support Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
Providing day-to-day administrative support to programme leads across multiple projects.
Supporting the coordination and delivery of projects, ensuring key tasks and deadlines are met.
Managing multiple shared email inboxes, responding to enquiries promptly and escalating queries where appropriate.
Maintaining accurate project documentation, records and information across relevant systems.
Supporting the preparation of project progress reports and analysing programme data.
Liaising with internal departments, external organisations and third-party suppliers.
Providing administrative and on-site support at events when required.
Logging, monitoring and maintaining records of incoming queries.
Attending meetings and supporting the identification of potential project issues or improvements.
Escalating any risks or issues that could impact project delivery.
About You
We are looking for someone with a strong administrative background, excellent organisational skills and a customer-focused approach.
You will ideally have:
A minimum of three A-Level passes at Grade C or equivalent.
Experience managing multiple tasks or activities simultaneously.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.
The ability to work independently, use your initiative and contribute effectively within a team.
Good problem-solving, research and time management skills.
A proactive approach, with the confidence to question existing processes and suggest improvements.
The ability to remain organised and work effectively under pressure and to deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine commitment to providing excellent customer service.

title: Trainee HR Administrator
description:
Thinking About a Career Change? Why Not Choose HR?

If you've reached a crossroads in your professional life and are looking for a fresh start in a people-focused, rewarding industry then Human Resources might be exactly what you're looking for.

Many of our candidates come from diverse professional backgrounds retail, customer service, administration, healthcare, education, hospitality, and more. What they all have in common is the desire to do meaningful work, support others, and build a stable, long-term career.

Our HR Career Change Programme

We specialise in helping individuals transition into HR-starting with recognised qualifications and ending with real job opportunities.

Whether you're working full-time, part-time, or in between roles, our online learning and personalised recruitment support can help you make a successful move into the HR profession often in just a few months.

Please note that this is a training course and fees apply.

Why Human Resources?

The HR profession is growing steadily across all sectors. As businesses put more focus on employee wellbeing, development, and company culture, skilled HR professionals are more important than ever.

Even entry-level roles in HR offer strong salaries, clear progression routes, and opportunities to specialise over time (in areas like learning & development, recruitment, employee relations, and more).

Here are typical UK salaries at various stages of the HR journey:
- HR Administrator - £27,000+
- HR Assistant - £30,000+
- HR Officer - £35,000+
- HR Advisor - £38,500+
- HR Manager - £55,000+

And with hybrid and remote roles increasingly common in HR, the flexibility is there too.

How It Works - Your 3 Step Journey Into HR

Step 1 - CIPD Level 3 Certificate in People Practice

The CIPD Level 3 Certificate in People Practice is the industry-standard entry point into Human Resources. It's assignment-based (no exams), and is delivered fully online with expert tutor support.
- Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Personnel & Development (CIPD)
- Covers recruitment, employee relations, HR systems, and more
- Complete in approx. 10-12 weeks at your own pace

This course not only boosts your employability-it also gives you the confidence and credibility to take the leap into a new industry.

Step 2 - Tailored Recruitment Support

Once you're qualified, our Recruitment Support Team will help you translate your background and new qualification into real job opportunities.

We've been helping career changers break into new roles since 2007-and our 4.8 Trustpilot rating shows how serious we are about your success.

You'll get:
- A professionally written, HR-focused CV
- Job-matching advice tailored to your experience and location
- Application support, interview prep, and mock interviews
- Ongoing 1-to-1 guidance to help you land your first HR role

Step 3 - Start Your New HR Career

Most of our candidates secure their first HR job within 3-6 months of qualifying-and often sooner if they're based near a major town or city.

And to give you confidence, we offer a Money Back Guarantee:
If we can't help you secure a role within 12 months of passing your qualification, we'll refund your training fees.

Flexible, Affordable, Achievable

To make things easier, we offer flexible payment options to spread the cost of your training over 12 months-so you can get qualified without financial pressure.

Ready to Make the Change?

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer your questions and help you take the first step towards a new, rewarding career in Human Resources.
